card.name: Linking words before nutrition or diet terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (that, for, is, a comma) in health-site text where a word like nutrition or nutritional would plausibly come next, such as diabetes food and recipe blurbs.

modes.label: Diabetes food blurbs
modes.description: Small words in diabetes recipe and healthy-eating teasers, where food or nutrition wording is expected next.
modes.example: Healthy food<< that>> tastes delicious too? No kidding.

modes.label: Health information site descriptions
modes.description: Linking words in descriptions of health information services, where nutrition or health wording could follow.
modes.example: We provide<< balanced>> expert news and information on living healthfully

card.writes: It pushes the model toward predicting nutrition-related words such as nut, nutrient and nutritional, and away from other word beginnings like ut or utr.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in health and diet blurbs where a word like nutrition is likely to come next.
